description: This file implements quantized tensor reduction operations such as mean and standard deviation, including fast paths optimized for specific tensor dimensions and support for QNNPACK. It defines functions for computing mean and std on quantized tensors, conditionally using QNNPACK or fallback methods. It also includes dispatch definitions and helper functions related to tensor dimensions and quantization parameters.

methods.name: bool is_innnermost_dim(const Tensor & self,OptionalIntArrayRef opt_dim)
methods.description: Checks if the specified dimensions are the innermost dimensions of the tensor.

methods.name: bool is_mean_inner_dim_fast_path(const Tensor & self,OptionalIntArrayRef opt_dim,std::optional<ScalarType> opt_dtype)
methods.description: Determines if the fast path can be used for mean calculation based on tensor dims and data type.

methods.name: Tensor qnnpack_mean(const Tensor & input,IntArrayRef dim,bool keepdim)
methods.description: Performs mean reduction using QNNPACK for 4D quantized tensors.

methods.name: Tensor & mean_out_quantized_cpu(const Tensor & self,OptionalIntArrayRef opt_dim,bool keepdim,std::optional<ScalarType> opt_dtype,Tensor & result)
methods.description: Calculates the mean of a quantized tensor, selecting a fast path or fallback as appropriate.

methods.name: Tensor mean_quantized_cpu(const Tensor & self,OptionalIntArrayRef opt_dim,bool keepdim,std::optional<ScalarType> dtype)
methods.description: Wrapper around mean_out_quantized_cpu that returns the result tensor.

methods.name: bool is_std_inner_dim_fast_path(const Tensor & self,OptionalIntArrayRef dim,const std::optional<Scalar> & correction)
methods.description: Checks whether fast path can be used for std calculation.

methods.name: Tensor & std_out_quantized_cpu(const Tensor & self,OptionalIntArrayRef dim,const std::optional<Scalar> & correction,bool keepdim,Tensor & result)
methods.description: Calculates the standard deviation of a quantized tensor, using fast path if possible.

methods.name: Tensor std_quantized_cpu(const Tensor & self,OptionalIntArrayRef dim,const std::optional<Scalar> & correction,bool keepdim)
methods.description: Wrapper that returns the std result tensor.
